topic: who reads a README and when
prompt_markdown: One sentence in this explanation is wrong. Which one?
hint: Ask who opens the README and what they are trying to do.

sentences.text: The first reader of a README is often its own author, weeks later.
A README is mainly there to impress reviewers, so longer is always better.
A volunteer should be able to run the script from the README alone.
A README is read before the code, not after it.
